chapter: Carnegie Hall, nicknames and later career
title: Fletcher Henderson's arrangements and Basie declining detail
summary: Asked about Fletcher giving him arrangements at the Grand Terrace, Basie says he knows a lot but will not tell it for a recording with no market.
